subject: Add "Continue with Google" to log in and account opening
body:
Customers can now log in or open an account with their Google account.
- New accounts still have to choose a country of residence, make the
  sophisticated-trader declaration for "Other", and accept the terms of
  business, exactly as on the email form.
- If the Google email matches an existing account, the two are linked.
- The button only shows when GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
  are set.
